name: School of Transmutation
summary: Wizards who reshape matter and craft a transmuter's stone.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.short: Copy transmutation spells for half the time and gold.
features.summary: The gold and time you must spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.short: Temporarily turn one material into another.
features.summary: You can spend 10 minutes per cubic foot to transform an object made of wood, stone (not gemstone), iron, copper or silver into another of those materials for 1 hour.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.short: Craft a stone that grants darkvision, speed, a save or a resistance.
features.summary: Over 8 hours you create a transmuter's stone. Its holder gains one benefit you choose: darkvision 60 ft., +10 ft. speed, proficiency in CON saves, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.short: Cast Polymorph on yourself without a slot.
features.summary: You add Polymorph to your spellbook. You can cast it without a slot to turn yourself into a beast of CR 1 or lower. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.short: Destroy your stone for a major transformation.
features.summary: As an action, you consume your transmuter's stone to: transmute a nonmagical object, remove all curses, diseases and poisons from a creature, cast Raise Dead without a slot, or reduce a creature's apparent age by 3d10 years.
